I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team: the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 382 seats.

Tobias posted that figure in #central-team on Oct 14, and Hollis is a member of that channel, so it was fine to repeat it there. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it didn't need approval. Tobias's message is the only record of it. The share has no Marrow account files, so I couldn't check it against a contract or the CRM, and I told Hollis that too.
